args.reason: The DoD goes beyond the PRD's declared goals. Only the first DoD item (dry run exits 0/1 per the floor decision without merging) serves the inspection goal. The second item persists every evaluation to .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl, and the third adds --explain with --since and --format to render a full historical timeline. The first PRD goal says plainly that historical storage and query features are outside this PRD, so these two items are capability no declared goal covers. The Phase-1 reason calls them a natural extension of inspection, but the PRD limits inspection to the current decision. The PRDR would be admissible if cut back to the dry-run item alone.
